mapper.sql: SELECT J.JOB_ID, J.JOB_NM, J.EXEC_CLASS_NM, J.WRK_MDUL_CD, J.SCHE_EXPR, J.MSFR_PLCY_CD, J.MLT_EXEC_YN, J.JOB_PARM_CONT, J.USE_YN, J.RMK, J.REFL_PRGM_ID, J.FIRS_REGR_ID, J.FIRS_REG_DT, J.FINA_REGR_ID, J.FINA_REG_DT, L.DSPT_EXEC_SN AS LAST_DSPT_EXEC_SN, L.EXEC_STAT_CD AS LAST_EXEC_STAT_CD, L.EXEC_ST_DTTM AS LAST_EXEC_ST_DTTM, L.EXEC_END_DTTM AS LAST_EXEC_END_DTTM, L.PROC_CNT AS LAST_PROC_CNT, L.SUCC_CNT AS LAST_SUCC_CNT, L.FAIL_CNT AS LAST_FAIL_CNT, L.ERR_MSG_CONT AS LAST_ERR_MSG_CONT FROM TB_DSPT_JOB_M J LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT DSPT_EXEC_SN, EXEC_STAT_CD, EXEC_ST_DTTM, EXEC_END_DTTM, PROC_CNT, SUCC_CNT, FAIL_CNT, ERR_MSG_CONT FROM TB_DSPT_EXEC_L WHERE JOB_ID = J.JOB_ID ORDER BY EXEC_ST_DTTM DESC, DSPT_EXEC_SN DESC LIMIT 1 ) L ON TRUE
mapper.insert: /* BatchJobMapper.insertBatchJob 배치직무를 등록한다. */ INSERT INTO TB_DSPT_JOB_M ( JOB_ID, JOB_NM, EXEC_CLASS_NM, WRK_MDUL_CD, SCHE_EXPR, MSFR_PLCY_CD, MLT_EXEC_YN, JOB_PARM_CONT, USE_YN, RMK, REFL_PRGM_ID, FIRS_REGR_ID, FIRS_REG_DT, FINA_REGR_ID, FINA_REG_DT ) VALUES ( #{jobId}, #{jobNm}, #{execClassNm}, #{wrkMdulCd}, #{scheExpr}, #{msfrPlcyCd}, #{mltExecYn}, #{jobParmCont}, #{useYn}, #{rmk}, #{reflPrgmId}, #{firsRegrId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{firsRegrId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: /* BatchJobMapper.updateBatchJob 배치직무를 수정한다. */ UPDATE TB_DSPT_JOB_M SET JOB_NM = #{jobNm}, EXEC_CLASS_NM = #{execClassNm}, WRK_MDUL_CD = #{wrkMdulCd}, SCHE_EXPR = #{scheExpr}, MSFR_PLCY_CD = #{msfrPlcyCd}, MLT_EXEC_YN = #{mltExecYn}, JOB_PARM_CONT = #{jobParmCont}, USE_YN = #{useYn}, RMK = #{rmk}, REFL_PRGM_ID = #{reflPrgmId}, FINA_REGR_ID = #{finaRegrId}, FINA_REG_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE JOB_ID = #{jobId}
